items.question: Who can attend Thrive?
items.answer: Thrive is for women ages 16 and older. You don’t need to attend Christ Community Church to join us.

items.question: Can I attend just one day?
items.answer: No. There are no single-day tickets. One $80 ticket covers Friday night and Saturday morning.

items.question: Can I register a group?
items.answer: Each person registers individually, and there isn’t a group rate. Send your friends the link and have each of them grab a ticket.

items.question: Is there a registration deadline?
items.answer: Registration stays open until tickets sell out.

items.question: Where should I park?
items.answer: Parking wraps around the whole building. Use the front entrance on the northwest corner, by the circle drive. [See the parking map](#parking).

items.question: Is food provided?
items.answer: Yes, and it’s included in your ticket. A dessert bar follows Friday’s session, and refreshments are available during Saturday’s break.

items.question: Who leads worship?
items.answer: The CCC Worship Team leads worship during the weekend.

items.question: Will there be merch?
items.answer: Yes. Thrive and Lisa Harper merchandise will be available for purchase at the event only. There’s no pre-order.

items.question: Can I help someone else attend?
items.answer: Yes. Add a scholarship gift of $25 or more when you register, and it goes toward another attendee’s ticket.
